hooks.name: Guard contracts
hooks.description: Block edits to src/contracts/ and ask Brandon for an approved change request.

action.command: node -e " const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs'); const { posix } = require('node:path'); const event = JSON.parse(readFileSync(0, 'utf8')); const input = event.tool_input ?? event.toolInput; const target = input?.path ?? input?.file_path ?? input?.filePath; if (typeof target === 'string') { const path = posix.normalize(target.replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(92), '/')); if (/(^|[/])src[/]contracts([/]|$)/i.test(path)) { console.error('BLOCKED: src/contracts/ is protected. Ask Brandon to approve a change request in docs/contracts/ before editing.'); process.exitCode = 2; } } "
